fichas.title: Loading Yards
fichas.summary: Planning guidance and illustrated layouts for loading yards serving department stores, shopping centres, and other shops. The page includes sales-area-based estimates for delivery provision, truck and ramp layouts, safety clearances, and guidance for covered yards. For shops up to approximately 200 m², smaller delivery vehicles may use normal car parks; larger shops should provide dedicated HGV parking. Vehicle swept paths and column locations should be checked.
